newsitem.title: UK: Ghana uses new equipment to monitor cocoa quality.
newsitem.headline: Ghana uses new equipment to monitor cocoa quality.

text.p: Ghana has introduced new equipment in ports to step up quality checks in cocoa shipments, the executive director of the country's cocoa board said on Thursday.
John Henry Newman of the Ghana Cocoa Board said the new equiment would be able to detect the quality of cocoa leaving the country to maintain high standards.
The measure was needed to achieve consistency in cocoa quality in the future although there were no complaints by buyers, he added.
"There is no problem on the quality. This year it should be as consistent as one can imagine," Newman told reporters during the meeting of the International Cocoa Organization (ICCO) said.
"But some of the traders are taking things for granted," he added.
Newman said the new equipment would be moved to the fields within the next 4-5 months to monitor the quality of the cocoa beans as they are picked up.
